title: Jacob charges his sons to bury him in the Machpelah cave
speaker: Jacob
note: Distinct from ot-genesis-v47-29 (Joseph alone); fulfilled in 50:12–13. 49:26–27 are blessings, out of scope.

title: Joseph orders the embalmers to prepare Jacob for burial
speaker: Joseph
note: Reported order; no record covers 50:1–3.

title: Joseph asks Pharaoh's court to request leave to bury Jacob
speaker: Joseph
note: Request precedes Pharaoh's permission (ot-genesis-v50-6) and cites Jacob's oath (ot-genesis-v47-29).

title: Pharaoh orders the Hebrew midwives to kill newborn boys
speaker: the king of Egypt (Pharaoh)
recipient: the Hebrew midwives Sepphora and Puah
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: The 1:16 order is unrecorded; only the later river decree (ot-exodus-v1-22) is itemized. The midwives refuse (1:17).

title: Moses' sister offers to fetch a Hebrew nurse for Pharaoh's daughter
speaker: Moses' sister
note: Proposal answered by 'Go' in ot-exodus-v2-8; the catalogue records similar proposals (Genesis 16:2, 30:3).

title: The Lord again sends Moses: go, and I will teach you
speaker: the Lord
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Renewed sending within the same call dialogue; only broad torah-exodus-4-1 covers it. 4:14 is prediction.

title: Pharaoh orders the taskmasters and scribes to withhold straw
speaker: Pharaoh
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 5:6 names the order's addressees; extend 5:7 to 5:6–7.

title: The taskmasters press Israel to complete the full daily quota
speaker: Pharaoh's taskmasters
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Distinct from Pharaoh's orders (5:7–9) and the relayed edict (ot-exodus-v5-11).

title: The scribes are told the brick quota will not be reduced
speaker: Pharaoh, through the taskmasters
note: Restates Pharaoh's unchanged quota (5:8, 5:18) as the scribes heard it.

title: The Lord sends Moses to proclaim redemption to Israel
speaker: the Lord
recipient: Moses, for the sons of Israel
note: Renewed charge to announce 'I am the Lord' and promised deliverance, as at 3:14–17; only broad torah-exodus-6-2 covers it.

title: The Lord sends Moses again to tell Pharaoh to release Israel
speaker: the Lord
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Renewed commission to go to Pharaoh (3:10); 6:12 is Moses' objection.

title: The Lord charges Moses and Aaron to bring Israel out of Egypt
speaker: the Lord
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Reported charge to both brothers, restating C0064 (3:10).

title: The Lord makes Aaron Moses' prophet before Pharaoh
speaker: the Lord
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Restates the spokesman arrangement of 4:15–16, now toward Pharaoh; 7:3–6 are prediction and fulfilment.

title: Moses is to speak to Aaron all that God commands
speaker: the Lord
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Same direction as 4:15 (C0076).

title: Pharaoh summons Egypt's wise men and sorcerers to match the sign
speaker: Pharaoh
recipient: the wise men and sorcerers of Egypt
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Reported summons without quoted speech; the similar summons in Genesis 41:8 is also unrecorded.

title: The Lord sends Moses, staff in hand, to Pharaoh at the river
speaker: the Lord
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Occasion-specific orders (morning, riverbank, staff) and the blood warning; only broad torah-exodus-7-14. Demand repeats F003; C0063 is generic.

title: The Lord sends Moses to demand release under threat of frogs
speaker: the Lord
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Frog warning precedes C0083 (8:1); only broad torah-exodus-7-14. 'Let My people go' repeats F003.

title: Pharaoh asks Moses and Aaron to pray away the frogs
speaker: Pharaoh
note: Like the later request ot-exodus-v10-17; no record covers 8:4.

title: Moses invites Pharaoh to set the time for removing the frogs
speaker: Moses
note: 'Appoint a time for me' with a promise of removal; Pharaoh answers 'Tomorrow' (8:6).

title: The Lord sends Moses at dawn to warn Pharaoh of hail
speaker: the Lord
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Sending and demand (9:13) precede F004's shelter warning (9:19); only broad torah-exodus-9-13.

title: Pharaoh confesses and asks Moses to pray for the hail to stop
speaker: Pharaoh
note: Request unrecorded; cf. ot-exodus-v10-17. 9:29 is Moses' promise.

title: Moses tells the elders to take a lamb for each family
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: Moses relays C0092 (12:3–5) to the elders; no record covers 12:21.

title: Moses tells the elders to slaughter the Passover
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: Relay of C0094 (12:6).

title: Apply the blood to lintel and doorposts with a hyssop bunch
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: Outside candidate list: C0095's hyssop detail comes from 12:22, which is linked only to C0110.

title: Keep the Passover service as a perpetual statute in the land
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: Restates C0103 (12:14) and applies it to life in the land.

title: Explain the Passover sacrifice when your children ask about it
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: C0088's 'its observances' fits, but 12:26–27 is unlinked. 12:28 is fulfilment.

title: Admit circumcised slaves; bar sojourners and hired workers from the Passover
speaker: the Lord
note: Rambam N126 (12:45) is not itemized; C0111's 'otherwise ineligible persons' covers it. Extend 12:43 to 12:43–45.

title: The whole congregation of Israel shall keep the Passover
speaker: the Lord
note: Universal obligation to observe; link to C0103 (12:14).

title: Keep the Unleavened Bread service yearly once in the land
speaker: Moses
note: Moses' Exodus-day charge restates C0231 (23:15).

title: Eat unleavened bread seven days, with a feast on the seventh
speaker: Moses
note: Same requirement as C0104 (12:15).

title: Let no leaven be seen with you within all your borders
speaker: Moses
note: Rambam N200 (no leaven seen) is missing; C0109 (12:19) itemizes only N201 (none found in houses).

title: Tell your son on the feast day what the Lord did
speaker: Moses
note: Rambam P157 is not itemized at 13:8; its substance is in C0088 (10:2, 'its observances'). Link here.

title: Set apart every firstborn male of womb and herd to the Lord
speaker: Moses
note: Restates C0115 (13:2) for life in the land; 13:13 is already itemized (C0118, C0119).

title: Explain the firstborn redemption when your son asks
speaker: Moses
note: Second children's-question formula; link to C0088 with 12:26–27 and 13:8.

title: Keep the deliverance as a sign on the hand and forehead
speaker: Moses
note: Repeats C0117 (13:9) within the same speech.

title: Joseph's oath about his bones is recalled and fulfilled
speaker: Joseph (recalled)
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Quotes the Genesis 50:25 charge as Moses carries the bones; 13:17 is narrative.

title: Gather an omer of manna per person for each household
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Specifies C0125's daily allowance (16:4); only broad torah-exodus-16-16 covers 16:16.

title: Gather six days; on the Sabbath there will be no manna
speaker: Moses
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Moses' form of the no-gathering rule given at 16:29 (C0130).

title: Jethro warns Moses the work is too heavy to do alone
speaker: Jethro
note: Rationale opening Jethro's counsel; extend 18:19 to 18:17–19.

title: Moses appoints leaders of thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens
speaker: Moses
note: Reported appointment carrying out ot-exodus-v18-20; cf. C0956 (Deuteronomy 1:13).

title: The Lord tells Moses to set the ordinances before Israel
speaker: the Lord
note: Heading charge like ot-exodus-v19-6 ('words you shall speak'); only broad torah-exodus-21-1 covers it.

title: Repay double when the stolen animal is found alive with the thief
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: C0188 (21:37) covers fourfold and fivefold restitution; the double-payment case is unitemized.

title: A thief caught stealing entrusted goods repays double
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Base case of the deposit law; C0193–C0195 cover the thief-not-found procedure (22:7–8).

title: Settle an unwitnessed loss of an entrusted animal by oath
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: 22:9 states the case whose ruling C0196 (22:10) records; extend to 22:9–10.

title: Do not pervert the justice due to the poor in his cause
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam N278 is missing; C0218 (23:2) is general and C0219 (23:3) forbids favouring the poor.

title: Rest on the seventh day so servants and animals are refreshed
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam P154 is itemized as C0152 (20:10) and C0129 (16:23); link 23:12.

title: Israel pledges to do all that the Lord has spoken
speaker: the people of Israel
note: Communal covenant pledge, cf. ot-nehemiah-v10-32 (Law); the same pledge at 19:8 is outside candidate list.

title: Make everything according to the pattern shown on the mountain
speaker: the Lord
note: Hebrews 8:5, already on C0252, quotes 25:40 itself; only broad torah-exodus-25-1 covers the verse.

title: Erect the tabernacle according to the plan shown on the mountain
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0252's pattern directive for erecting the tent; 26:15–25 are covered by C0271.

title: Make the altar hollow, of boards, as shown on the mountain
speaker: the Lord
note: Construction detail of the altar in C0277 (27:1–5); 27:9–18 are covered by C0281.

title: Clothe Aaron in the vestments and his sons in tunics and turbans
speaker: the Lord
note: Rite steps unitemized between C0303 (29:4) and C0304 (29:10); same directive as 28:41.

title: Pour the anointing oil on Aaron's head
speaker: the Lord
note: Ordination-rite step matching C0298 (28:41).

title: Consecrate the hands of Aaron and his sons; priesthood theirs forever
speaker: the Lord
note: Matches C0299 (28:41); 29:9 also declares a perpetual priesthood.

title: Carry out the priests' ordination over seven days
speaker: the Lord
note: Seven-day ordination charge to Moses; C0459 (Leviticus 8:33) covers the priests' attendance, C0326 only successors.

title: Anoint Aaron and his sons to serve as priests
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0298 (28:41); also link C0299 (consecrate).

title: Consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve as priests
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0299 (28:41).

title: Keep the Sabbaths as the lasting sign between God and Israel
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Sabbath-as-covenant-sign command is unitemized; C0354 covers only the death penalty (31:14–15). Cf. ot-ezekiel-v20-20.

title: God calls Bezalel by name and fills him with skill
speaker: the Lord
note: Outside candidate list: Bezalel's appointment precedes C0353 (31:6–11, 'him and Eliab'); extend to 31:2–11.

title: Aaron recounts ordering the people to remove their gold
speaker: Aaron
note: Aaron's retelling of his 32:2 order; ot-exodus-v32-22 stops at 32:23.

title: The Lord tells Moses to lead the people up to the land
speaker: the Lord
note: Outside candidate list: repeats C0358 (32:34); Moses quotes it at 33:12. 33:12–23 are prayer and promise.

title: Observe all that the Lord commands this day
speaker: the Lord
note: Covenant-renewal opening; 34:9–10 are prayer and promise.

title: Make no covenant with the inhabitants of the land
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0244 (23:32); 34:16 is already ot-exodus-v34-16.

title: Tear down their altars, pillars, groves and carved images
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0242 (23:24).

title: Do not bow down to another god, for God is jealous
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0148 (20:5).

title: Do not make cast gods for yourself
speaker: the Lord

title: Keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread in the month of new grain
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0231 (23:15).

title: Eat unleavened bread seven days at the appointed time
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0104 (12:15).

title: Every firstborn male of womb and flock belongs to the Lord
speaker: the Lord
note: Outside candidate list (context verse); repeats C0115 (13:2).

title: Redeem the firstborn donkey with a sheep or pay its value
speaker: the Lord
note: Rambam P81 is itemized as C0118 (13:13); link 34:20.

title: Redeem every firstborn son
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0119 (13:13).

title: Do not appear before the Lord empty-handed
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0232 (23:15).

title: Rest on the seventh day, even at sowing and harvest
speaker: the Lord
note: Rambam P135 (seventh-year land rest) is itemized as C0227 (23:11); the plain sense here is weekly rest, so link C0152.

title: Keep the Feast of Weeks at the start of wheat harvest
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0233 (23:16).

title: Keep the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0234 (23:16).

title: All males appear before the Lord three times a year
speaker: the Lord
note: Rambam P53 is itemized as S134 (Deuteronomy 16:16–17); link 34:23–24 (23:17 sits only in S050).

title: Do not offer sacrificial blood with leaven
speaker: the Lord
note: Rambam N115 is itemized as C0235 (23:18); link 34:25.

title: Do not leave the Passover sacrifice until morning
speaker: the Lord

title: Bring the first produce of your land to the Lord's house
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0237 (23:19).

title: Do not offer a lamb in its mother's milk
speaker: the Lord
note: Rambam N187 is itemized as C0238 (23:19); link 34:26.

title: Work six days; the seventh is a holy Sabbath rest
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: Moses relays the Sabbath law; 35:3 is already C0365.

title: Whoever works on the Sabbath shall die
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord

title: Bring a willing offering of gold, silver and sanctuary materials
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: Moses relays C0251 (25:2–7); 35:5 is the candidate.

title: Let every skilled person come and make all the Lord commanded
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: Moses relays C0353 (31:6–11) and lists the items; covers candidate 35:19 (P00226).

title: Moses announces God's call of Bezalel and Eliab
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: Restates 31:2–6; 35:29 and 36:5–39:23 are fulfilment narrative, not directives.

title: Place the ark and screen it with the veil
speaker: the Lord
note: Set-up repeat of C0274 (26:33); C0367–C0370 itemize the other set-up steps.

title: Bring in and arrange the table and the lampstand
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0275 (26:35); 'set out its presentation' also relates to C0264.

title: Place the gold incense altar before the ark
speaker: the Lord
note: Outside candidate list: first half of 40:5 (C0368 covers only the screen); repeats C0336 (30:6).

title: Anoint and sanctify the tent, its utensils and the altar
speaker: the Lord

title: Wash Aaron and his sons at the tent doors
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0303 (29:4).

title: Clothe Aaron in the holy robes and his sons in tunics
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0297 (28:41).

title: Anoint Aaron and his sons for a lasting priesthood
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0298 (28:41); 40:15 adds the perpetual anointing.

title: Sanctify Aaron to serve as priest
speaker: the Lord
note: Repeats C0299 (28:41). 40:16–33 are fulfilment narrative.

title: Burnt offerings may be unblemished male flock animals or birds
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Flock and bird cases of C0371 (1:2–3), whose title already names birds.

title: Lay a hand on the flock burnt offering
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Flock case of C0372 (1:4).

title: Slaughter the flock burnt offering north of the altar
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Flock case of C0373 (1:5); the north side is its prescribed location.

title: Priests pour the flock offering's blood around the altar
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Flock case of C0374 (1:5).

title: Divide the flock burnt offering limb by limb
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Flock case of C0376 (1:6).

title: Priests arrange and burn the whole flock offering on the altar
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Flock case of C0378 (1:8–9).

title: Wash the flock offering's entrails and feet
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Flock case of C0379 (1:9).

title: Prepare oven, griddle and pan grain offerings unleavened with oil
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Baked forms of C0386 (2:1, 'prescribed form'); 2:6 adds breaking and oiling the pieces.

title: Burn the memorial portion of the baked grain offering
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Same requirement as C0387 (2:2).

title: The rest of the baked grain offering belongs to the priests
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Same requirement as C0388 (2:3).

title: Offer firstfruit grain as roasted crushed groats with oil and frankincense
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: The firstfruits grain offering is unitemized; C0391 covers only leaven-and-honey firstfruits (2:11–12).

title: Peace offerings from the flock: an unblemished lamb or goat
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Flock cases of C0394 (3:1).

title: Lay hands on the lamb or goat peace offering
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Flock cases of C0395 (3:2).

title: Slaughter the lamb or goat at the tent doors
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Flock cases of C0396 (3:2).

title: Priests pour the lamb or goat's blood around the altar
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Flock cases of C0397 (3:2).

title: Remove the fat, loin, kidneys and liver lobe of flock offerings
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Flock cases of C0398 (3:3–5); 3:9 adds the whole fat loin.

title: The priest burns the flock offering's fat on the altar
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Flock cases of C1232 (3:3–5).

title: Ruler brings a male goat; commoner a female goat or ewe
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam P69 is itemized as C0400 (4:3, with 4:13–14); add the ruler's and commoner's cases.

title: Elders or offender lay hands on the sin offering
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: C0401's title names elders and offender but cites only 4:4.

title: Slaughter each sin offering at its prescribed place
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Congregation, ruler and commoner cases of C0402 (4:4).

title: The anointed priest brings the calf's blood into the tent
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Congregation case of C0403 (4:5–6).

title: Sprinkle the calf's blood seven times before the veil
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Congregation case of C1233 (4:5–6).

title: Put the blood on the horns of the incense altar
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Congregation case of C0404 (4:7).

title: Pour out the remaining blood at the base of the altar
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Congregation, ruler and commoner cases of C0405 (4:7).

title: Remove all the fat of the sin offering
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Later cases of C0406 (4:8–10).

title: Burn the sin offering's fat on the altar
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Later cases of C1234 (4:8–10).

title: Burn the congregation's sin-offering calf outside the camp
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Congregation case of C0407 (4:11–12).

title: Put the blood on the horns of the altar of burnt offering
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Commoner cases of C0408 (4:25).

title: Keep the altar fire burning, adding wood every morning
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam P29 is itemized as C0428 (6:2); link 6:5–6, which add the morning wood.

title: Do not let the altar fire go out
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam N81 is itemized as C0429 (6:2); link 6:5–6.

title: Priests burn a handful of the grain offering as its memorial
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: The law of the grain offering restates C0387 (2:2).

title: Aaron's male descendants eat the grain offering in the holy court
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam P88 is itemized as C0388 (2:3); link 6:9 and 6:11.

title: Eat the priests' grain portion unleavened; never bake it with leaven
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam N124 is missing; C0389 (2:11) bars leaven in the altar offering, not in the priests' portion.

title: Slaughter sin offerings where burnt offerings are slaughtered
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam P64 (sin-offering procedure) is itemized as C0400 and C0402 (4:3–4); link 6:18.

title: Every male priest may eat the sin offering
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Restates C0437 (6:19).

title: Give oven- and pan-cooked grain offerings to the officiating priest
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Allocation rule unitemized (cf. C0446, the hide to the officiating priest, 7:8). 7:11 is a heading.

title: Share uncooked grain offerings equally among all Aaron's sons
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Companion allocation rule to 7:9; unitemized.

title: Eat no fat of cattle, sheep or goats
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam N185 is itemized as C0399 (3:17); link 7:23 and the penalty in 7:25.

title: Use fat of carcasses and torn animals for work, never as food
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Distinct permission and prohibition; unitemized.

title: Eat no blood of bird or beast in any dwelling
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam N184: only C0019 (Genesis 9:4) itemizes the blood ban; link 7:26–27, with the penalty in 7:27.

title: The priest burns the peace offering's fat on the altar
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Same requirement as C1232 (3:3–5).

title: The breast and right foreleg of peace offerings belong to the priests
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Perpetual due first given at Exodus 29:27–28 (C0324); 7:37–38 are a colophon.

title: The right foreleg goes to the priest who offers blood and fat
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Officiating-priest allocation like C0446 (7:8); C0324 assigns the portions only to the priests generally.

title: Take Aaron, his sons, vestments, oil and the ordination offerings
speaker: the Lord
note: Carries out C0302 (Exodus 29:1–3); 8:4–30 narrate Moses performing Exodus 29.

title: Moses tells Aaron's house to boil the flesh at the tent door
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: Moses relays C0327 (Exodus 29:31).

title: Aaron and sons eat the ordination flesh and bread there
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: Moses relays C0328 (Exodus 29:32–33).

title: Burn what remains of the ordination flesh and bread
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: Moses relays C0330 (Exodus 29:34).

title: Remain at the tent door seven days and keep the Lord's charge
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: 8:35 restates and completes C0459 (8:33), adding 'so that you do not die'; extend to 8:33–35.

title: Eat the remaining grain offering unleavened beside the altar
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: Moses applies C0388 (2:3) on the day of Nadab and Abihu's deaths; cf. the proposed 6:9–10 record.

title: Eat the breast and foreleg in a clean place with your household
speaker: Moses, relaying the Lord
note: Sons and daughters may share these portions (cf. Numbers 18:11, also unitemized); C0324 sets only the due.

title: Priests must eat the sin offering in the holy place
speaker: Moses
note: Moses enforces C0437 (6:19) and the rule of C0441; 10:19–20 is Aaron's reply.

title: Touching a dead clean animal defiles until evening
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Clean-animal carcass case of C0472's rule (11:24–31); 11:40 is already C0478.

title: Be holy, for I the Lord am holy
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Same call as S070 (Leviticus 19:2), quoted in 1 Peter 1:16 (A087); C0479 covers only the creeping-things ban.

title: Do not break a bone of the Passover
speaker: the Lord
note: Outside candidate list: 12:46 (Rambam N123's verse) repeats C0101's ban (12:10) but is linked only to C0112 and C0113.

title: Keep everything the Lord has said
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Outside candidate list: 23:13a is unlinked (C0229 and S049 cover only the other-gods clause); same as 34:11.

title: Aaron proclaims a feast of the Lord before the calf
speaker: Aaron
note: Outside candidate list: public proclamation between ot-exodus-v32-2 and C0355; recording it does not approve it. 32:6 is narrative.

summary: Genesis 49:26–Leviticus 11:45: 30 new, 111 parallel, 7 extend; most gaps are repeated laws to link (Exodus 34, 40; Leviticus 1–4), plus unitemized orders (midwives, Jacob's burial charge, plague sendings) and laws (Sabbath sign; Rambam N124, N200, N278).
